title: FairLMs: A Turnkey Library for Fairness in Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Providing a turnkey library (FairLMs) that implements 33 intrinsic and extrinsic metrics, including WEAT, SEAT, and CrowS-Pairs, to measure biased associations in word embeddings, sentence representations, and masked-token probabilities.
Integrating dataset diagnostics to evaluate stereotype leakage and utilizing benchmarks like StereoSet to measure stereotypical bias across different language model representations.
